description: This Java source file defines the 'DocumentsSample' Android activity, which provides a user interface for demonstrating the usage of the Android 'DocumentsContract' API. It includes functionality to open, create, read, write, delete, and rename documents through various intent-based interactions with the Android Storage Access Framework.

classes.name: DocumentsSample
classes.description: An Android activity demonstrating document operations such as open, create, read, write, delete, and rename using the DocumentsContract API.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity UI with buttons for various document operations and sets up click listeners.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles the result of document-related activities, performing operations such as reading, writing, creating, deleting, or renaming documents based on the request code.

methods.name: createDocument
methods.description: Creates a new document at the specified URI with given MIME type and display name.

methods.name: renameDocument
methods.description: Renames the specified document URI to a new name.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs messages and displays them in the output view.

methods.name: readFullyNoClose
methods.description: Reads all bytes from an InputStream into a byte array without closing the stream.

methods.name: closeQuietly
methods.description: Closes a Closeable resource quietly, ignoring exceptions.
